name: Who I Am
overview: Scripture reveals that our identity is deeply rooted in God's intentional design and loving purpose, as He formed us intimately even in the womb (Psalms 139:13) and has plans of peace and hope for our lives (Jeremiah 29:11). Believers are granted the privilege to become children of God through faith in Christ (John 1:12) and are called friends of Jesus, sharing in the knowledge He has received from the Father (John 15:15). This identity assures us of no condemnation for those who live by the Spirit (Romans 8:1) and affirms our honored status as a crown of glory in God's hand (Isaiah 62:3).
